name: Team Frontress
//server_keys: Dedicated servers connect with one of these (tf_gc_server_key, or $GC_SECRET). Give every community that runs servers its own. anticheat_authority: Easy Anti-Cheat bans this key's servers report keep players out of matchmaking -- only for servers you run.
//anticheat: Easy Anti-Cheat. require_protected_servers: matches only go to servers running a protected session. temp_ban_hours: how long an EAC temporary ban keeps a player out of matchmaking. steam_game_bans: Steam game bans (public, permanent) through ICheatReportingService with the publisher key ($STEAM_PUBLISHER_KEY); mode off, manual (the moderator console and admin API) or auto (also every permanent EAC ban from an anticheat_authority server); app_ids default to auth.app_id/app_ids; immediate skips Valve's ban delay; forward_player_reports files in-game cheating reports with Steam too.
//regions: Matchmaking regions. A player's region is the one they set with tf_mm_region (the region picker on the play screen), else the region of the server their game pings best, else the region holding the Steam relay data center they ping best (pops). A region's matches play on servers whose region is its id: set tf_gc_server_region (ru, eu, na) on each server, or region on its server key. Players in Russia usually ping European relays best (hel, sto, waw), so without a server in ru they play in eu. region_wait_secs: after that long a party plays with anyone, on any server it reaches (server_ping). Without regions everybody is one pool.
//server_ping: Before a match takes a server, every player's game pings the pool and the match only goes to a server all of them reach. max_ms: the highest ping allowed (-1: only check the server answers). answer_secs: how long to wait for a game's pings before it is not held back (older builds never ping).

match_groups.name: Ranked 6v6
match_groups.//enabled: Off: Frontress has no ranked mode yet. The menu only offers groups the GC enables.

//support: The support tab: Steam microtransactions. publisher_key (or $STEAM_PUBLISHER_KEY) needs the microtransaction permission. Keep sandbox on until the store is live; fake is for dev auth only.
//webhooks: Other projects hear about matches and the war here: match_started, match_result, match_ended, quest_finished, war_sector_captured, war_campaign_won, war_campaign_started.
